real: Moody's warns it may cut the US credit rating
anon: A credit rater warns it may cut the nation's top grade
note: Moody's placed the US Aaa rating on review for possible downgrade on 13 July 2011. Moody's own release URL is from memory and unverified; a Mondo Visione copy of the release exists at https://mondovisione.com/news/moodys-places-us-aaa-government-bond-rating-and-related-ratings-on-review-for-p-2011713/

real: Euro leaders agree a second rescue package for Greece
anon: Leaders agree a second rescue for an indebted country
note: Euro area summit statement of 21 July 2011 (archive copy of the official statement; Council of the EU press PDF also exists).

real: Obama signs the debt ceiling deal on deadline day
anon: The president signs a deal to raise the borrowing limit
note: Budget Control Act of 2011 (Public Law 112-25) signed 2 August 2011; Treasury had named 2 August as the date it would run out of borrowing room.

real: Over the weekend, S&P strips the US of its AAA rating
anon: Over the weekend the nation loses its top credit grade
note: S&P announced the downgrade to AA+ after the close on Friday 5 August 2011 (evening); first trading day after is Monday 8 August. Source is a third-party copy of S&P's research update; CRS report R41955 at https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/R41955.html also covers it.

real: Fed pledges near-zero rates until at least mid-2013
anon: The central bank promises cheap borrowing for years
note: FOMC statement of 9 August 2011 (released about 2:15pm ET).

real: Fed launches Operation Twist to push long rates lower
anon: The central bank moves to push long-term loan costs down
note: FOMC statement of 21 September 2011 (released about 2:15pm ET): extend maturity of holdings of Treasuries.

real: EU deal halves Greek private debt, boosts rescue fund
anon: A deal cuts a struggling country's debts in half
note: Euro Summit statement dated 26 October 2011; deal reached overnight and announced early 27 October Brussels time before the US open. The 50 percent is a nominal discount on privately held Greek debt.

real: Fed and other central banks make dollar loans cheaper
anon: Central banks team up to make emergency loans cheaper
note: Coordinated action announced 30 November 2011 by the Fed and the central banks of Canada England Japan the euro area and Switzerland to lower the price of dollar swap lines.

real: ECB cuts its rate to 1% and offers banks 3-year loans
anon: A central bank cuts rates and offers banks long loans
note: ECB press release of 8 December 2011: main refinancing rate down 25 basis points to 1.00 percent and two three-year longer-term refinancing operations announced.
